title: A principled representation of elongated structures using heatmaps
mechanism: Encode a curve's nominal position and positional uncertainty as a heatmap by convolving the curve distribution with a filter, approximated in linear time by a distance-dependent function.
adaptation: Filter width per source set from measured label-to-ridge offsets (team E: 48% of label points within 1 px of the ridge); regression head separate from the CE head so it cannot widen the argmax; read out by ridge NMS and draw at per-source width.
min_experiment: Arm PF + heatmap regression head (MSE), two read-outs (aux only; heatmap-NMS drawn at source width) vs PF; metric relF1@2 and strict IoU on CV; kill if relF1@2 +<0.01 in both read-outs.
evidence: Approximation error analysed vs curve type and SNR; applied to surgical 2D/3D data, semantic boundaries, skeletonisation. No crack test; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF 5; related to T2 soft_band_jml (soft band inside the CE target) but different head and loss
